scoreboard.title: Free Online Scoreboard for TV & Projector — Punkto
scoreboard.description: Keep score for two teams online. A big, readable scoreboard for the TV or projector with goal scorers, match clock and winner screen. Free, no sign-up, works offline.
scoreboard.h1: Free online scoreboard for two teams
scoreboard.intro: Punkto turns your laptop into a scoreboard. Add points with one tap and show the score full-screen on a TV or projector — it updates instantly. Made for football, basketball, volleyball, table tennis or any game with two sides.
steps: Name the match and the two teams. Add logos and players if you like.
Tap +1, +3 or your own point values. Made a mistake? Use −1, undo, or click the score and type it.
Click “Display”, move the window to the TV or projector and press F for fullscreen. It stays in sync while you score.

features.d: Built for screens across the room: big numbers, team colours, goal scorers and an optional match clock.
Pick who scored with one tap. Every goal is listed with its minute, and wrong ones are removed in a click.
End the game to show the final score with a little confetti. Every result is kept in the board's history.

faq.q: Can I use it for basketball or volleyball?
faq.a: Yes. Choose the point buttons when you create the scoreboard — for example 1, 2, 3 for basketball. You can also type any score by hand.

faq.q: Do I need to install anything?
faq.a: No. Punkto runs in the browser. You can install it as an app from the browser menu, and it works offline after the first visit.

faq.q: How do I show the score on a TV?
faq.a: Connect your laptop to the TV or projector, open the display view in a second window and drag it to that screen. Keep scoring in the first window — the display follows instantly.

leaderboard.title: Free Leaderboard Maker — Live Online Leaderboard — Punkto
leaderboard.description: Create a live leaderboard in seconds. Add players or teams, give points, track rounds and show the ranking on a big screen. Free, no sign-up, private.
leaderboard.intro: Make a live leaderboard for any competition. Add players or teams, give points with one tap and watch the ranking sort itself. Show it full-screen on a TV or projector and crown the winners on a podium.
steps: Give your leaderboard a name and choose your plus and minus buttons.
Add players or teams — paste a whole list at once if you have one.
Give points and the ranking updates itself. Press “End game” to show the podium.

features.d: The leaderboard re-ranks itself after every change, with gold, silver and bronze for the top three.
Track points per round and see a round-by-round table, on your screen and on the big display.
The display view sizes itself so every name stays readable, even on a projector at the back of the room.

faq.q: How many players can a leaderboard have?
faq.a: As many as you need. The display arranges them in columns, so around 40 names stay readable on one screen.

classroom.title: Classroom Points Tracker & Class Scoreboard — Free — Punkto
classroom.description: Track class or team points on the projector. A free classroom scoreboard with rounds and a winner podium. No sign-up — pupils' names stay on the teacher's device.
classroom.h1: Classroom points tracker for the projector
classroom.intro: Reward teamwork, homework or good behaviour with points your class can see. Punkto shows a big, colourful ranking on the projector and keeps everything on your own device — no accounts for you or your pupils.
steps: Create a board and paste your class list or the names of your table groups.
Give points during the lesson with one tap — or with the keyboard, without touching the mouse.
Show the ranking on the projector and celebrate the winners at the end of the week.

features.d: No sign-up and no server: names and scores are stored only in your browser. With Premium, no ad code is loaded at all.
Pick a pupil with the number keys and add points with + or −. Mistakes are fixed with one undo.
Keep one board running all term, or end a game every Friday and keep the results in the history.

faq.a: Punkto stores no personal data on any server — names stay in the teacher's browser. Please still follow your school's own rules.

faq.q: Does it work on an interactive whiteboard?
faq.a: Yes. Open Punkto on the whiteboard's computer: the large buttons work with touch, and the display view fills the screen.

faq.q: Do pupils need their own devices?
faq.a: No. Only the teacher uses Punkto; the class simply watches the projector.

quiz.title: Quiz Scoreboard for Pub Quiz & Trivia Nights — Free — Punkto
quiz.description: Run your quiz night with a live scoreboard on the TV. Enter each round's points, show the ranking and a winner podium. Free, no sign-up, works offline.
quiz.intro: Hosting a pub quiz or trivia night? Enter every team's points per round in seconds and show a live leaderboard on the TV. When the last round is done, the winners get a podium and confetti.
steps: Create a leaderboard and add the team names.
After each round, type the points into the round table — Enter jumps to the next team.
Show the standings between rounds and the podium at the end of the night.

features.d: See each team's points per round and the running total, on the host screen and on the TV.
After the first visit Punkto works offline — handy in venues with bad internet.
Put your logo on the board. Premium also removes the ads and the Punkto badge.

faq.q: How do I fix a wrong score?
faq.a: Click the number in the round table and type the correct one, or press Ctrl+Z to undo the last change.

faq.q: Can I run a quiz every week?
faq.a: Yes. End the game to save the result in the history, then start the next quiz on the same board — or duplicate it.

faq.q: Can guests see who is leading?
faq.a: Yes. The ranking is always sorted by total points, and the TV can switch between the ranking and the round table.

score-keeper.title: Online Score Keeper for Games — Free, No Sign-up — Punkto
score-keeper.description: Keep score for board games, card games and family game night. Add points per player, track rounds and see who wins. A free online score keeper that works offline.
score-keeper.h1: Online score keeper for game night
score-keeper.intro: Stop scribbling on paper. Punkto keeps score for card games, board games, darts or bowling: add points per player, track rounds and let the app do the maths — then show the winner on a podium.
steps: Create a leaderboard and add the players.
Set point buttons that fit your game — or type each round's score into the rounds table.
Press “End game” to crown the winner. The result is saved in the history.

features.d: Totals, ranks and round scores are calculated automatically — no more adding-up mistakes.
Many games take points away. Set your own minus buttons or type negative scores.
Keep a record of past games and see who won last time.

faq.q: Which games does it work for?
faq.a: Any game where players collect points: card games, board games, darts, bowling, mini golf, video game tournaments and more.

faq.q: What if the lowest score wins?
faq.a: Punkto ranks the highest total first. For games where the lowest score wins, enter the points as negative numbers.

faq.q: Does it work on my phone?
faq.a: Yes. The control view is made for phones, and Punkto works offline after the first visit.
